---
title: q.bt Roadmap
---

Only open work is listed here. Completed items are removed.

## Planned

- [ ] Event-driven execution kernel shared by batch backtests and `q.gym`
- [ ] `q.bt.run` adapter for model signals
- [ ] LEAN CLI adapter for executing local backtests and reports through a
			typed `q.bt` API
		- configure a LEAN workspace, project, engine image, parameters, and data root
		- launch, monitor, cancel, and reproduce `lean backtest` runs
		- parse result JSON, logs, orders, trades, charts, and data-request reports
			into QRT-owned result objects
		- generate HTML/PDF reports and preserve links to the original LEAN artifacts
		- support custom-market registration and report compatibility without
			mutating source backtest results
- [ ] Keep the LEAN adapter optional: LEAN remains a standalone execution
	engine, while QRT's in-process event kernel remains separately usable
- [ ] Transaction costs / slippage models
- [ ] Trade log output compatible with `q.plot` (tearsheets)
